mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen above 0.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% and a rise in residential sales above $450 billion signals strong consumer confidence and robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0% and RSAFS > 450000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,150 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1150 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% over one month signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) over two months signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (year-over-year) above 2.0% indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth (year-over-year) > 2.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL growth (year-over-year) > 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
